title: Sun Kissed | KEY.co
description_expanded: Situated in the charming Gulf Place community, Sun Kissed is surrounded by palm-lined streets, inviting patios, and plenty of green spaces to savor the relaxed coastal lifestyle. A short stroll brings you to some of 30A’s favorite dining spots like Shunk Gulley and The Perfect Pig, offering everything from casual bites to elevated culinary experiences. With Ed Walline Regional Beach Access less than half a mile away, complete with ADA accessibility, picnic shelters, and lifeguards during peak season, this home combines convenience, comfort, and endless opportunities for coastal adventure. Sun Kissed is where timeless memories are made by the Emerald Sea. Sun Kissed is a beautifully designed coastal retreat in the heart of Gulf Place, perfect for multi-generational families or groups seeking a memorable escape on 30A. This thoughtfully appointed home features four spacious bedrooms, including one on the main floor, and an open-concept living area that brings everyone together for shared meals and relaxing evenings. For a quieter moment, step outside to the private backyard and unwind around the fire pit in cozy outdoor seating. Located next to the community pool and just a short ride from the beach, Sun Kissed makes it easy to enjoy all the best of Gulf Place and 30A with included bikes and a golf cart.
